steps.action: Format and display the work brief
steps.context:
You are producing a work brief to re-orient the user into this project only. Read project-local Git state and TODO.md before generating the brief. Do not query a cross-project index, hub, vault, or external memory.

Generate a rich, structured brief in this order:

1. RIGHT NOW - display right_now_section verbatim. If it contains insufficient recent context, read at most the two newest project-local `.exocortex/events/*.md` files and reconstruct the last work, decisions, next actions, and blockers.

2. SHORT-TERM - display shortterm_memory verbatim.

3. SUBCONSCIOUS NUDGE - display subconscious_nudge if non-empty.

4. GIT STATE - run read-only Git status, branch, and recent-log commands. List each modified or untracked path and flag a branch that appears pending integration.

5. OPEN ITEMS - read project-local `.exocortex/OPEN_DECISIONS.md` when present and identify unresolved decisions or overdue local actions.

6. NEXT TASK - show the first incomplete task group from the Ready section of `.exocortex/TODO.md`.

Then show the A/B/C choice. Name actual local evidence and identify uncertainty instead of guessing.
